settings.keywords: structural, 2 storey building, plane frames, 12 columns

building.note: The 4 x 3 column grid is a PLAN; this drawing is the three X-direction FRAME LINES in elevation, side by side. Each has its own fixed bases, so the solver treats them as three independent components of one stiffness matrix.
building.loadNote: Beam UDLs are the Slab object's tributary edge load for a 6.0 x 5.0 panel; interior frame lines collect from both sides.
